author: ValWood
body:
* **ARBA rule (ID and label):**


GO:0015101 | organic cation transmembrane transporter activity | IEA with ARBA00028683

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

many

* **Description of issue**

This is a large family of polyamin/amino acid transporters

For amino acids 
GO:0015101 | organic cation transmembrane transporter activity
would not be quite right because they have both positive and negative charge
title: ARBA00028683 GO:0015101	 organic cation transmembrane transporter activity

author: cmungall
body:
The GO term doesn't make much sense, I proposed its obsoletion here: 

https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/30715

I think
https://www.uniprot.org/arba/ARBA00028683

Could be redirected to point up to something like transmembrane transport... but then I think most of the rules would become redundant with simpler `A -> B` rules in interpro2go

author: ValWood
body: I agree transmembrane transport would be sufficient.

author: Antonialock
body: so this issue will be fixed with the obsoletions.
